Show the collector information in the top-right corner exactly as Series B and 20/20 inside the same fixed warm vanilla label box on every card, with dark chocolate outline and dark chocolate text. Place the Uncommon rarity mark directly below it in the same top-right area, inside the same fixed warm vanilla label box size and shape used across the whole series, with dark chocolate text and the Series B uncommon rarity-label border design with a double line. Only the rarity label border pattern may change; do not change the label fill color, label text color, or main card rim color. Keep the composition clean, balanced, cheerful, and easy for kids to understand, with attention going first to the character, then to the nickname, then to the collector info and rarity mark. Avoid realism, polished rendering, gradients, 3D rendering, painterly rendering, cinematic lighting, detailed anatomy, complex perspective, complex scene depth, gameplay stats, attack text, rules text, battle system icons, clutter, logos, and watermarks.
